system.model: config.py → ollama/llama3.2 (default); openai and gemini via INBOXHERO_LLM
system.preference_demo: msg_064: never auto-approve spend over $5k — escalate to Priya Shah

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns exactly one disposition and reason to all 100 messages; obvious mail never reaches a model.
capabilities.observable: Writes dispositions.json with coverage for msg_001…msg_100; prints rules_only_count (17) and HOSTILE INBOX section.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply drafts (RAG)
capabilities.claim: Drafts replies only from retrieved mail; cites message ids; abstains when evidence is missing.
capabilities.observable: drafts.json: msg_064 drafted citing msg_009+$20,000 and msg_002 prefs; msg_074 cites Option A; unanswerable_demo has insufficient_evidence and null body.

capabilities.name: Gated irreversible actions
capabilities.claim: Dry-run by default; human approval on execute; sends only to outbox/ with undo window; logs every gated decision.
capabilities.observable: Dry-run prints proposed send/soft_delete/permanent_delete/archive; --execute --yes writes outbox/ and logs/gated_decisions.jsonl.

capabilities.name: Standing preferences after restart
capabilities.claim: Records never_auto_approve_spend_over; after exit/restart, msg_064 escalates to CFO.
capabilities.observable: apply prints disposition escalate with honoured_memory_key never_auto_approve_spend_over for msg_064.

capabilities.name: Hostile inbox defense
capabilities.claim: Detects assistant-directed instructions, refuses them, logs refusal, leaves messages in place.
capabilities.observable: HOSTILE INBOX lists msg_007 and msg_035 with attempted actions; nothing written to outbox for them; still in inbox.json.

capabilities.name: Three-pane run dashboard
capabilities.claim: Builds pending / flagged / commitments views from a completed run with multi-message cites and conflict callouts.
capabilities.observable: dashboard.html embeds dashboard_data.json; commitments include cmt_board_0918 citing two messages; overlapping Thu 11:00 meetings marked conflict.

capabilities.name: Mark digests as read
capabilities.claim: CrewAI triage agent marks daily/weekly digest emails as read without touching VIP or urgent mail.
capabilities.observable: outputs/mark_read.json lists digest ids (e.g. weekly summaries); mailbox_state.read updated; Maya/Jordan messages absent.

capabilities.name: Soft-delete phishing spam and ads
capabilities.claim: CrewAI cleanup agent soft-deletes phishing, spam, and cold ads; refuses Part 6 hostile messages.
capabilities.observable: outputs/soft_delete_batch.json: phishing/cold pitch soft_deleted; msg_007/msg_035 status refused and not in trash.

capabilities.name: Agentic reply with Slack and calendar
capabilities.claim: CrewAI multi-agent run drafts a reply from email thread + slack.json + calendar.json + prefs; auto-stages VIP simple acks or holds high-stakes asks.
capabilities.observable: outputs/agent_reply.json for msg_085 decision auto_stage_outbox with cited_slack_ids and cited_calendar_ids; --hold-demo on msg_064 yields hold_for_human.

capabilities.name: Interactive Gmail demo UI
capabilities.claim: Serves a white Gmail-like inbox with Agent Mode On landing, disposition-derived Pending actions with citations, Reply/Reply-all/CC/BCC Send-to-outbox with learn-from-edit toasts, and provider-agnostic chat via config.py.
capabilities.observable: Browser at /app/: Agent Mode On landing; Primary unread; Pending shows many disposition-gated rows with cite chips; compose Send writes outbox/ and may toast learned prefs; chat uses configured LLM provider.
capabilities.evidence: app/, scripts/serve_app.py, config.py, demo.py, outbox/, drafts.json, memory/standing_instructions.json, mailbox_state.json, trace.jsonl, logs/gated_decisions.jsonl
